messages:
alex: Heads up — saw a perf regression on Llama3-13b runs with the chatpad template. 95/99th token latency up ~18–22% compared to yesterday's baseline. Repro on canary.

maria: ugh. any obvious kernel flips or selector changes in the deploy log?

alex: yeah, selector switched some batches to `sampler_fused` between 15:02 and 15:04 UTC. small snippet from the runtime log:```selector: decision(batch=8, seq_mean=120) -> sampler_fused (score=0.82) fallback=matmul_fused```

perf-bot: [deploy-bot] canary selector change applied at 2026-03-17T15:03:12Z, monitors enabled. :rotating_light:

jordan: can you paste a reduced nvprof trace or the flame view? also does chatpad make the prefix much longer (KV hotness)?

alex: reduced nvprof capture (trimmed):```GPU timeline: memcpyH2D 1.2ms | sampler_fused_kernel_1 0.8ms | sampler_fused_kernel_2 0.6ms | memcpyD2H 2.1ms  <-- repeated pattern with gaps due to small kernels
Observed: memcpy stalls + kernel launch overhead stacking up for short kernels.```

kai: interesting — `sampler_fused` assumes head-interleaved layout and 32-aligned head blocks. if head_dim alignment is off (padding not a multiple of 32) we get extra compute/padding that amplifies tiny-kernel overhead. what's model manifest head_dim?

alex: model manifest: `hidden_size=5120, n_heads=40, head_dim=128` so alignment looks fine numerically, but our runtime alignment for fused kernels rounds to 64-blocks on some GPUs. also chatpad long system prompt increases KV depth -> more small KV ops.

maria: another angle: RMSNorm+SiLU path currently misses a fused kernel on this GPU driver combo which forces elementwise fallback and increases op count. that + sampler small-kernel burst explains the launch overhead.

alex: tried forcing older matmul path locally: `FORCE_KERNEL=matmul_fused ./bin/runtime ...` results: p95 back to baseline, but peak mem +150MB and slightly higher average GPU util. memcpy stalls drop significantly though.

jordan: hypothesis: selector -> sampler_fused + KV-prefetch + chatpad long-prefix => many small kernels + memcpy churn -> launch latency dominates. reproduce microbench: run batcher with sample-only path and toggle `--kv-prefetch` off.

alex: running microbench now. command used:```./bin/runtime-bench --model llm3-13b --variant chatpad --batch 8 --iters 300 --profiles selector,mem,copy --kv-prefetch=off``` will paste results in ~10m.

perf-bot: Perf test queued (#2391). ETA ~12m.

maria: if this reproduces, tentative rollout plan: 1) rollback canary selector to matmul_fused, 2) add a head-dim alignment check and warning in model manifests, 3) add runtime flag to disable fused-sampler when RMSNorm+SiLU detected, 4) add kv-prefetch throttling for long-prefix templates.

alex: agree. I'll add a small patch to selector where it scores fused-sampler lower when `model.meta.ops` contains `RMSNorm-SiLU` or when `prefetch-depth > 64`. cc @kai for kernel-side alignment sanity checks.

kai: I'll look at padding logic and try a micro-kernel that supports odd paddings. if we can reduce launch count for sampler path or fuse memcpy, that'll help. Posting a draft kernel tweak shortly.

alex: thanks — will attach bench outputs when ready. :thumbsup:
